msg: Hello, your goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible. The first thing that you need to know is that there are two types of forest that you will be going to. There is one bright forest that has a red basket in front, and there is one dark forest with a yellow basket in front. One of these two forest will give you more mushrooms than the other for a period of time. After a certain amount of time, the forest that was giving you more mushrooms will now give you less and the other forest that was giving you less mushrooms will now give you more. However, you will not be directly picking which forest to go to. Instead you will have to pick which gnome will guide you there.                      You will be picking from 8 different gnomes. All of the gnomes will have different colors. The color of the gnome is the only thing you have to pay attention to. So if they have a different outfit or a different hat it does not matter. The gnomes can be divided into 2 groups. One group of gnomes will take you to the dark forest with the yellow basket and one group will take you to the bright forest with the red basket. The red, blue, green, and orange gnomes will take you to the bright forest. The pink, purple, yellow, and brown gnomes will take you to the dark forest. The gnomes will also be in fixed pairs so it will be orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow, and blue & purple. They may change sides but the pair groupings will stay the same. The multipliers that shows up will not change anything that was said above other than how many mushrooms you will get for that round. Other than that just remember to stay focused and press S or K and then the space bar. Good luck to you.
